name: Yanhua Shengqi Qian
source: A healing school visual novel set in the seaside town of Umihara. Thirty days before the summer festival, transfer student Yu Natsume joins the festival committee and grows closer to five girls.
translation: A healing school visual novel set in the seaside town of Umihara. Thirty days before the summer festival, transfer student Yu Natsume joins the festival committee and grows closer to five girls.
